name: 강철톤
scene: Deep steel foundry hangar, orderly graphite beams, cold silver overhead light and restrained warm amber floor reflections.
motifs: Steel-gray interlocking polygonal segments become sleek chest, shoulder, hip and shin plates; long rock spikes become short angular silver plate edges; two long ridges become paired narrow brow ornaments; no creature head mask. Metallic silver and graphite with tiny red sensor accents.

casual.scene: Empty industrial design exhibition booth at noon, displaying a small polished metal geometry sample on one open hand, other hand relaxed separately beside waist. Head to just above knees, bright diffuse skylight.
casual.outfit: Original industrial exhibition presenter event fashion: opaque silver sleeveless high-neck fitted mini dress with graphite side panels and a modest side slit, graphite heels and small hexagonal earrings. Bare arms and legs, secure chest and pelvis coverage, no real workplace insignia.

casual.scene: Empty metalcraft hobby studio at sunset, polishing a small unlettered hexagonal pendant with a soft cloth, each hand clearly separate over the workbench. Complete head and both hands, copper sunset bounce and cool task lamp.
casual.outfit: Opaque charcoal sleeveless square-neck cropped denim vest, high-waisted silver-gray trousers, tiny red gem ear studs. Bare shoulders, arms and midriff, no armor.

casual.scene: Empty mountain railway observation deck at frosty sunrise, taking a small sideways step toward railing, face turned toward camera. One hand rests on rail and other open beside hip, entire body and shoes visible. Misty tracks and cool pale dawn.
casual.outfit: Opaque ivory sleeveless mock-neck knit top, high-waisted graphite knee-length culottes, sturdy ankle shoes and tiny silver segmented bracelet. Bare arms and lower legs, ordinary travel fashion.
